```artifact
Feature: Alarms

  Scenario: High Leakage Alarm
    Given the system is running
    When the average leakage over 10 seconds is 3.1 L/min
    Then the high leakage alarm is active
    And the high leakage alarm has high priority

  Scenario: High Leakage Alarm - Boundary
    Given the system is running
    When the average leakage over 10 seconds is 3 L/min
    Then the high leakage alarm is not active

  Scenario: High Leakage Alarm - Invalid
    Given the system is running
    When the average leakage over 10 seconds is -1 L/min
    Then an error message is displayed indicating invalid input

  Scenario: Involuntary Shutdown Alarm
    Given the system is running
    When the involuntary shutdown alarm is triggered
    Then the involuntary shutdown alarm is a continuous-tone alarm
    And the involuntary shutdown alarm emits a sound tone for at least 2 minutes

  Scenario: Involuntary Shutdown Alarm - Priority
    Given the system is running
    When the involuntary shutdown alarm is triggered
    Then the involuntary shutdown alarm has high priority

  Scenario: AC Mains Power Loss Alarm
    Given the system is running
    When the AC mains power is lost
    Then the AC mains power loss alarm is triggered
    And the AC mains power loss alarm has medium priority

  Scenario: AC Mains Power Loss Alarm - Sensor Connection
    Given the system is running
    When the AC mains power sensor is connected
    Then the AC mains power loss alarm is triggered

  Scenario: Continuous-Tone Alarms
    Given the system is running
    When a continuous-tone alarm is triggered
    Then the alarm subsystem supports continuous-tone alarms

  Scenario: AC Mains Power Loss Alarm - Boundary
    Given the system is running
    When the AC mains power is lost for 2 minutes
    Then the AC mains power loss alarm is triggered
```
